name: Workday
scope_notes: Covers Workday (HCM/Financials tenant APIs: SOAP WWS, REST, RaaS). Covers core Workday tenants; many authentication-policy, OAuth and REST API reference pages on doc.workday.com and Community require customer login and were not readable, so several items are unknown.

controls.name: OAuth 2.0 Clients Enabled
controls.what: Tenant-wide switch that allows OAuth 2.0 clients to call the Workday API.
controls.setting: Edit Tenant Setup - Security > OAuth 2.0 Settings

controls.name: Disable OAuth 2.0 client
controls.what: Disable a compromised API client to stop further use of its credentials.
controls.setting: API client related actions (exact task name not public)

controls.name: Scope (Functional Areas)
controls.what: Limits an API client to selected functional areas.
controls.setting: Register API Client / Register API Client for Integrations

controls.name: Integration System Security Group domain permissions
controls.what: ISU access is limited to domains granted to its security group.
controls.setting: Create Security Group (Integration System Security Group) + Maintain Permissions for Security Group

controls.name: Non-Expiring Refresh Tokens
controls.what: When checked, refresh tokens do not expire; leave unchecked to keep expiry.
controls.setting: Register API Client for Integrations > Non-Expiring Refresh Tokens

controls.name: Enforce 60 Minute Access Token Expiry
controls.what: Caps OAuth 2.0 authentication at 60 minutes for the client.

controls.name: Do Not Allow UI Sessions
controls.what: Prevents the ISU from signing in to the Workday UI.

controls.name: Authentication policies with IP restrictions
controls.what: Authentication policy rules can target the ISU security group and restrict by IP and allowed authentication types.
controls.setting: Manage Authentication Policies; Activate All Pending Authentication Policy Changes

controls.name: Maintain Password Rules (System Users exempt from password expiration)
controls.what: Adding an ISU here stops its password from expiring; leaving it off keeps tenant expiry.

controls.name: Manage Refresh Tokens for Integrations
controls.what: Regenerates the refresh token for a client and ISU.
controls.setting: API client related actions > API Client > Manage Refresh Tokens for Integrations

controls.name: Enable Security Emails
controls.what: Needed for X.509 certificate expiration notifications.
controls.setting: Edit Tenant Setup - Security > Security Email Settings

controls_unknown: Whether authentication-policy IP rules are enforced on each API request or only at sign-in/token issuance (authentication policy pages require login).
Whether disabling an API client or regenerating a refresh token invalidates already-issued access tokens (docs say tokens can be replayed within their lifetime).
Exact task names to disable/delete an API client and to revoke a refresh token.
Default access-token lifetime for integration clients.
Whether ISU password authentication bypasses SAML SSO / IdP conditional access.
Whether User Activity Logging records web service (SOAP/REST) calls made by ISUs; the activityLogging REST API reference requires login.
Audit event names for API client creation, refresh token generation, or client disablement.

credentials.name: Integration System User (ISU) user name and password

authentication.summary: An admin creates a non-person ISU with the Create Integration System User task and sets its password. Integrations send the ISU user name and password to Workday web services.

federation.details: Public docs do not say whether ISU password logins bypass SAML/SSO. Do Not Allow UI Sessions blocks UI sign-in only. ISUs can be given their own authentication policy rule (example allows User Name Password).

ip_restriction.boundary: Authentication policies support IP restrictions and can target the ISU's security group. Public docs do not say whether this is checked per web service request or only at authentication.

lifetime.summary: Password follows tenant password rules; ISU can be exempted from expiration; session timeout 0 = no expiry

renewal.summary: Same password is reused until an admin changes it.

administration.summary: Created with Create Integration System User; access comes from Integration System Security Group domain permissions.

sso.details: Authentication policies can include a rule for the ISU security group, but the ISU signs in with user name and password rather than through SSO.

offboard.details: An ISU is a dedicated non-person system account.

sso.ui: Manage Authentication Policies > Authentication Ruleset: rule for the ISU's security group > Allowed Authentication Types; then Activate All Pending Authentication Policy Changes

network.ui: Manage Authentication Policies > Authentication Ruleset: rule for the ISU's security group > Authentication Condition > Create IP Range; then Activate All Pending Authentication Policy Changes

expiry.ui: Maintain Password Rules > System Users Exempt from password expiration (remove the ISU to make its password expire)

usage.ui: View User Activity report (filter System Account = ISU); ISU related actions > Security Profile > View Signon History

log_sources.name: Update Audit report
log_sources.notes: Sign-on/sign-off times and invalid password use per account. Requires System Monitoring / Update Audit domains.

log_sources.name: View User Activity report / User Activity data source / /activityLogging REST API
log_sources.notes: Must be enabled in tenant setup; 30-day retention; export weekly. Coverage of web service calls not stated.

log_sources.name: API Activity Reports
log_sources.notes: Monthly aggregates incl. Top 10 IP Addresses; up to 13 months; US and EU only.

anomaly_cues: ISU sign-ons from IPs outside the integration's known egress
Invalid password attempts on ISU accounts
Spike in ISU activity or new tasks/reports accessed

containment.steps: Change the ISU password and/or restrict it with an authentication policy; exact disable task not public.
containment.notes: Session Timeout 0 means ISU sessions do not time out.

unknown: Exact audit event names for ISU password changes
Whether SOAP reads by ISUs appear in User Activity

calls.reveals: Public and private worker data within ISU security
calls.log_notes: Workday says it doesn't log GET requests or unsuccessful requests for web services; whether SOAP reads appear in User Activity is not stated.

unknown: No documented whoami call for ISUs

credentials.name: API Client for Integrations with refresh token (Manage Refresh Tokens for Integrations)

authentication.summary: Admin registers an API Client for Integrations, then generates a refresh token bound to an ISU. The holder exchanges client ID, secret and refresh token for access tokens at /ccx/oauth2/<tenant>/token.

federation.details: Refresh token is minted by an admin for the ISU without an interactive sign-in; docs do not address IdP conditional access.

ip_restriction.boundary: Public docs do not say whether authentication policy IP rules apply to OAuth token issuance or bearer requests.

lifetime.summary: Non-Expiring Refresh Tokens option; access/refresh expiry configurable

renewal.summary: Access tokens are obtained with the refresh token; admins can regenerate the refresh token from the client.

administration.summary: Register API Client for Integrations task; Scope (Functional Areas) limits the client; data access comes from the ISU's security groups.
administration.conditions: OAuth 2.0 Clients Enabled must be on in tenant setup.

offboard.details: The refresh token is generated for an ISU, not a person.

inventory.details: A View API Clients report exists; docs only show it used to find the REST endpoint, not to list every client and token.

inventory.ui: View API Clients report; per client: related actions > API Client > Manage Refresh Tokens for Integrations

usage.ui: View User Activity report (filter System Account = the bound ISU)

token_format.notes: Client ID is a base64 string; refresh token is an opaque string.

log_sources.name: View User Activity / /activityLogging
log_sources.notes: Records acting account (the bound ISU); opt-in; 30 days.

log_sources.name: View User or Task or Object Audit Trail
log_sources.notes: Configuration changes by account/task/object; event names for API clients not public.

credential_id_fields.notes: Shows the ISU, not the API client ID (client field not documented).

anomaly_cues: Refresh token regenerated outside change windows
Client with Non-Expiring Refresh Tokens used from new IPs

containment.steps: Disable the affected OAuth 2.0 client; regenerate the refresh token; review the ISU's security groups.
containment.notes: Workday says compromised access tokens can be replayed within their lifetime.

unknown: Whether disabling the client revokes outstanding access tokens

calls.log_notes: GET requests are not logged per web service limits page.

unknown: REST whoami endpoint not readable in public docs

credentials.name: API Client with JWT Bearer Grant (x509 public key)

authentication.summary: Admin registers an API client with Client Grant Type Jwt Bearer Grant, uploads an x509 public key and binds an ISU. The holder of the private key signs JWT assertions to get access tokens.

federation.details: No interactive sign-in; docs do not address SSO or conditional access.

lifetime.summary: Key valid until the x509 certificate expires or is replaced; access token expiry configurable

renewal.summary: Each JWT assertion yields a new access token; no stored refresh token.

administration.summary: Register API Client task with Jwt Bearer Grant, x509 Certificate and Integration System User fields.
administration.conditions: Expiry emails for x509 certificates require Enable Security Emails.

offboard.details: The JWT bearer client is bound to an ISU, a non-person account.

inventory.details: View API Clients report; coverage of all clients not described.

usage.ui: View User Activity report (filter System Account = the bound ISU)

log_sources.name: View User Activity / /activityLogging
log_sources.notes: Acting account is the bound ISU.

anomaly_cues: New x509 public key added to an API client
Token requests for the client from unexpected networks

containment.steps: Disable the API client and replace the x509 public key.
containment.notes: Access tokens already issued may be replayable until expiry.

unknown: Audit event names for x509 key changes

authentication.summary: A registered API client uses the authorization code grant; a Workday user signs in and the app gets access and refresh tokens acting as that user.

federation.details: The user signs in through normal Workday sign-in; MFA-enrolled users must complete MFA. After consent, refresh tokens are used without re-authentication.

ip_restriction.boundary: Authentication policies apply at user sign-in; per-request enforcement for bearer tokens is not documented publicly.

lifetime.summary: Optional Non-Expiring Refresh Tokens; Enforce 60 Minute Access Token Expiry; session timeouts apply

renewal.summary: App refreshes access tokens with the user's refresh token.

administration.summary: Register API Client task; scopes are functional areas.
administration.conditions: OAuth 2.0 Clients Enabled must be on.

sso.details: Users enrolled in Workday MFA must pass a second factor during the authorization-code sign-in; docs do not say later token use is re-checked.

inventory.details: View API Clients report lists API clients; no documented list of user-issued tokens.

sso.ui: Manage Authentication Policies > Authentication Ruleset: rule for the users' security group > Allowed Authentication Types

usage.ui: View User Activity report (filter System Account = the consenting user)

token_format.notes: Opaque bearer access token and refresh token.

log_sources.name: View User Activity / /activityLogging
log_sources.notes: Acting account is the consenting user.

anomaly_cues: User activity from a third-party client's IPs outside business use

containment.steps: Disable the API client; reset the user's sessions/password as needed.

unknown: How to revoke one user's refresh token for a client

calls.reveals: Worker data visible to the user
